tasks.name: health-check
tasks.prompt: Check all active pipeline health. Report failures to operator.

tasks.name: morning-brief
tasks.prompt: Summarize overnight logs. Report via Telegram.

tasks.name: marketing-scan
tasks.prompt: Run engagement research cycle: scan Reddit, HN, and Twitter for MCP-related mentions. Use python3 scripts/engagement/cli.py research. Log all findings to DuckDB. Report new opportunities via Telegram.

tasks.name: marketing-engage
tasks.prompt: Process pending engagements: draft replies using LLM and post to approved platforms. Use python3 scripts/engagement/cli.py engage --approval auto. Log results to DuckDB.

tasks.name: daily-marketing-brief
tasks.prompt: Summarize yesterday's engagement across all platforms. Report new leads and conversion metrics. Post to Telegram.

tasks.name: marketing-followup
tasks.prompt: Check conversation threads needing follow-up. Scan DuckDB for engagements with replies that need responses. Draft follow-up replies.

tasks.name: token-refresh
tasks.prompt: Check all platform OAuth tokens and refresh any expiring within 24h.

tasks.name: weekly-digest
tasks.prompt: Generate weekly engagement report by platform. Include total mentions, replies posted, new leads, and conversion rate.

tasks.name: bookkeeping-prep
tasks.prompt: Review this week's expenses. Categorize transactions. Flag missing receipts.

tasks.name: reddit-india-monitor
tasks.prompt: Check r/developersIndia for MCP/opensource mentions. Reply if relevant opportunity found. Log to engagement DuckDB.

tasks.name: telegram-india-poll
tasks.prompt: Poll Indian developer Telegram groups for keyword mentions (mcp, opensource). Engage with relevant discussions.

tasks.name: foss-united-check
tasks.prompt: Check FOSS United for upcoming events and open proposals. Report any CFP deadlines.

tasks.name: hasgeek-cfp-check
tasks.prompt: Check HasGeek conference homepages for CFP openings. Report any active CFPs.

tasks.name: engagement-digest
tasks.prompt: Generate weekly engagement digest from DuckDB. Report total engagements by platform and any notable interactions.

tasks.name: daily-report
tasks.prompt: Generate daily engagement report. Summarize yesterday's activity across all platforms. Use: python scripts/engagement_loop.py daily

tasks.name: engagement-weekly-digest
tasks.prompt: Weekly engagement digest by platform. Generate summary of past week's activity, top leads, engagement stats. Use: python scripts/engagement_loop.py weekly

tasks.name: v2ex-trending-check
tasks.prompt: Check V2EX trending topics in python/programmer/share nodes. Identify opportunities to engage with MCP/AI/opensource discussions. Log findings to engagement DuckDB with zh_CN tag.

tasks.name: juejin-trending-check
tasks.prompt: Check Juejin trending articles about MCP/opensource/AI topics. Identify opportunities to engage. Log to engagement DuckDB with zh_CN tag.

tasks.name: zhihu-hot-trending
tasks.prompt: Check Zhihu hot topics list for MCP/AI/opensource related trending discussions. Report any relevant hot topics. Log to engagement DuckDB with zh_CN tag.

tasks.name: wecom-announcement
tasks.prompt: Send weekly WeCom announcement to target groups with latest MCP/opensource content published this week. Draft message in Chinese. Log to engagement DuckDB with zh_CN tag.

tasks.name: chinese-engagement-digest
tasks.prompt: Generate weekly Chinese engagement digest from DuckDB. Report total engagements by Chinese platform (V2EX, Juejin, CSDN, Zhihu, WeCom) and any notable interactions. Log digest to engagement DuckDB with zh_CN tag.

tasks.name: campaign-metrics
tasks.prompt: Collect Fast HTML MCP campaign metrics. Poll GitHub stars and npm downloads, log to campaign_metrics table. Use: python scripts/campaign_manager.py metrics

tasks.name: campaign-status
tasks.prompt: Report Fast HTML MCP campaign daily status. Show current day, pending tasks, and latest metrics. Use: python scripts/campaign_manager.py status

tasks.name: campaign-morning-brief
tasks.prompt: Generate campaign morning brief. Check what day of the launch week we're on, list pending tasks, fetch latest metrics. Highlight any blocking issues.

tasks.name: visual-content-cross-post
tasks.prompt: Process pending visual content queue. Use python3 scripts/visual_platforms/cli.py cross-post process-queue. Publish approved content to TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and Facebook. Log results to DuckDB.

tasks.name: visual-content-daily-metrics
tasks.prompt: Collect yesterday's engagement metrics from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Facebook Pages. Use python3 scripts/visual_platforms/cli.py facebook insights and related commands. Store in DuckDB visual_engagements table.

tasks.name: visual-content-token-check
tasks.prompt: Check all visual platform OAuth tokens. Verify TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN, INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN, YOUTUBE_ACCESS_TOKEN, FACEBOOK_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN are valid. Refresh any expired tokens. Report failures via Telegram.

tasks.name: odw-metrics-poll
tasks.prompt: Collect office-oxide-mcp campaign metrics. Poll GitHub stars for Aimino-Tech/opendocswork-mcp and npm downloads for @aimino/opendocswork-mcp. Log to campaign_metrics table. Target: 500 stars in 30 days.

tasks.name: odw-x-mentions-scan
tasks.prompt: Scan X/Twitter for mentions of office-oxide-mcp, opendocswork, 'mcp office', 'mcp document'. Log findings to campaign_metrics table. Flag any negative sentiment requiring response.

tasks.name: odw-campaign-status
tasks.prompt: Report office-oxide-mcp multi-platform campaign daily status. Show campaign day number (started 2026-06-10), today's scheduled content pieces from config/odw-multi-platform-campaign.json, pending tasks, latest GitHub stars and npm downloads. Highlight any blocking issues.

tasks.name: odw-engagement-monitor
tasks.prompt: Check all ODW campaign threads for new replies needing response. Scan Reddit, HN, LinkedIn, X for replies to our posts. Draft responses for pending replies.

tasks.name: odw-hn-check
tasks.prompt: Check Hacker News for Show HN: office-oxide-mcp post. Monitor upvotes and comments. Report if post hits front page or gets significant traction. Log to campaign_metrics table.
